categories.main_business_segments: Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation operates primarily in five business segments: geophysics, drilling engineering, logging and mud logging, special downhole operations, and engineering construction. These segments cover the full oilfield service chain from exploration, drilling, completion, production, to transportation and construction services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as 2D and 3D seismic exploration, autonomous excitation systems, offshore OBN nodes, rotary geo-steering, high-temperature and high-pressure well logging, electric fracturing, and digital oilfield technologies. Production methods emphasize efficiency improvements like shortening drilling cycles, modular construction, mechanized operations, and informatization management. The company also invests heavily in R&D with over 1,000 patents and focuses on intelligent drilling, ultra-deep well technologies, and carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS).
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic and international oil and gas exploration and production companies, including Sinopec Group, China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC), and China Oil & Gas Pipeline Network Corporation (PipeChina). The company serves over 70 basins and 550 blocks in China and operates in more than 30 countries, with significant contracts in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Ecuador, and Mexico.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across Mainland China and overseas markets including the Middle East (notably Saudi Arabia and Kuwait), Latin America (Ecuador and Mexico), and other international regions. Overseas business accounts for approximately 22.6% of total revenue, with overseas assets representing 35.4% of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation operates primarily as a midstream and downstream service provider in the oilfield services supply chain, offering integrated petroleum engineering and technical services including exploration, drilling, well logging, downhole operations, and engineering construction. It also provides equipment leasing and technical support services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development, technological innovation, and market expansion. R&D focuses on intelligent drilling, ultra-deep well technologies, digital oilfield platforms, green and low-carbon technologies including electrification of equipment and CCUS. It aims to build a world-class technology-leading oilfield service company with emphasis on high-end, green, intelligent, and international development paths.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts for petroleum engineering and technical services, including geophysical exploration, drilling, logging, downhole operations, and engineering construction. Revenue recognition is based on progress of contract performance over time. The company also earns income from equipment leasing, sales of products, and government grants.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading integrated oilfield service provider in China with strong market positions domestically and growing presence internationally. It competes with major oilfield service companies such as Schlumberger, Halliburton, and Weatherford in overseas markets. It holds top rankings in drilling contractors for Saudi Aramco, Kuwait Oil Company, and Ecuador National Oil Company.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of RMB 81.1 billion, a 1.4% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 631.6 million, a 7.2% increase. Total assets reached RMB 77.3 billion with net assets of RMB 8.65 billion. The company maintains a high gearing ratio of approximately 69.8%. It has shown steady growth in contract values, especially in overseas markets with a 45.5% increase in new contracts abroad.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinopec Oilfield Service Corporation emphasizes its comprehensive full-chain oilfield service capabilities, advanced proprietary technologies, and strong execution ability. It differentiates through high-quality, efficient, and innovative services, including localized core technologies for shale gas and ultra-deep wells. The company also focuses on green and intelligent oilfield services, integrating new energy solutions such as hydrogen and geothermal development, providing customers with value through technological leadership and cost-effective operations.
